confirmedBoundaries: Seven deployments and three configuration/activation calls each require a fresh explicit review and wallet confirmation; no nonce or deployment address is predicted.

PMON and self immutable runtime substitutions, complete implementation bytecode, ERC1967 slots, UUPS identity, all required owner roles, registry/NFT/engine/wrapper relationships, token branding/backing/burn/owner/lock and actual-address EIP712 domain are verified.

Current owner/account/chain/provider, review identity/version, expiry and mounted state are checked after deferred work and synchronously before wallet entry. Network/account away-and-back, dismissal and unmount scenarios make zero send attempts.

Saved hashes survive reload, pending transactions block new sends, only confirmed cancelled/reverted states may be explicitly cleared, and manual same-nonce recovery still requires the exact successful step transaction and current deployed state.
The canonical19-field export with all10 five-field receipt records is accepted by the backend manifest function; only a complete verified prefix can be exported.
Published artwork commitment is recomputed with the approved catalog and metadata path, and the NFT token-metadata base incorporates the actual fresh collection address.
limits: Browser and helper checks use synthetic local wallets, receipts and RPCs. This review does not establish a production deployment or fresh backend/indexer activation.
The backend check exercises its manifest-schema function only. Actual chain chronology/CREATE-address checks and source/reader admission remain the separate backend validator and owner workflow.

The token implementation was authored separately by this reviewer; its source/contract validation is recorded in its own package. This verdict is an independent review of the owner helper/page authored by another agent.
The unmount guard prevents future wallet entry, and does not attempt to cancel a wallet RPC already explicitly invoked.
